text: Planning a trip can be exciting, but it also takes time and effort. You need to choose a destination, book tickets, and pack your bags. When you travel, you meet new cultures and try delicious food you have never tasted before. However, language barriers can sometimes make things difficult. You might not understand what people say, and they might not understand you. But these challenges often lead to funny and unforgettable memories. Travelling teaches you about the world and about yourself. Every journey gives you stories to share with friends and family for years to come.
